Callout.Name: Severe Limb Bleeding
Callout.Message: Person bleeding heavily from a leg wound.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, pressure applied by a bystander.

Script.Line: The glass came down with the window and it went into the leg.
The man in the van is still holding it. He has not let go.
I am cold. Is it the blood? Is that why I am cold.

Callout.Patient: It has gone cold. Why has it gone cold?

Lines.Approach: The bystander is doing the right thing and has not let go. That is the only reason this is not worse.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
